class.name: OpenWorldTerrain3D
class.description: [OpenWorldTerrain3D] renders sparse terrain tiles and displaces them in the vertex shader using tile height data from [OpenWorldTerrainData]. Empty grid cells are not rendered until a tile is created for that cell.

method.name: apply_brush
method.description: Applies a brush edit to the CPU height data and refreshes the generated height texture.

method.name: apply_brush_with_delta
method.description: Applies a brush edit and returns changed [code]indices[/code], [code]before[/code], and [code]after[/code] arrays for undo/redo.

method.name: apply_height_patch
method.description: Applies normalized height values to the given height data indices.

method.name: apply_layer_brush
method.description: Paints manual low, mid, or high layer weights into [member OpenWorldTerrainData.layer_data]. [param alpha] controls the painted override alpha. [param blend_mode] controls how the selected layer weight is blended with existing painted weights.

method.name: apply_layer_brush_with_delta
method.description: Paints manual layer weights and returns changed [code]indices[/code], [code]before[/code], and [code]after[/code] arrays for undo/redo.

method.name: apply_layer_patch
method.description: Applies manual layer paint values to the given layer data indices.

method.name: generate_random_terrain
method.description: Fills [member terrain_data] with deterministic value-noise heights and refreshes rendering.

method.name: create_grid_cell
method.description: Creates one flat sparse terrain tile at integer grid coordinate [param cell].

method.name: get_brush_hit
method.description: Intersects a world-space ray against the CPU height field and returns hit information for editor tools.

method.name: has_grid_cell
method.description: Returns whether a sparse terrain tile exists at integer grid coordinate [param cell].

method.name: remove_grid_cell
method.description: Removes the sparse terrain tile at integer grid coordinate [param cell].

method.name: get_debug_lines
method.description: Returns local-space debug lines used by the editor gizmo.

method.name: get_height_texture
method.description: Returns the first generated tile height texture used by the built-in displacement material. The terrain internally uses one height texture per tile.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Rebuilds the patch mesh, refreshes the height texture, and reapplies the active material.

method.name: reset_flat_terrain
method.description: Fills the terrain with a flat normalized height and refreshes rendering.

members.member: Target normalized height used by flatten brush operations.
Convenience proxy to [member OpenWorldTerrainData.height_scale].
Normalized height blend width used between low, mid, and high texture layers.
Controls brush edge softness. A value of [code]0.0[/code] makes brush influence nearly constant inside the radius; larger values concentrate influence toward the brush center.
Strength of texture-driven ambient occlusion. A value of [code]0.0[/code] disables the AO texture contribution.

If enabled, the built-in material reduces visible texture repetition by applying low-frequency coordinate warping and optional macro color variation. This affects material sampling only and does not modify terrain height data.
Strength of procedural coordinate warping used by anti-tiling. Keep this value low to avoid visible texture swimming or stretched normals.
Multiplier color for the high elevation layer.
Normalized height where the high elevation layer starts to dominate.
Triplanar normal texture used for high elevations and steep slopes. If unset, the terrain uses its generated height normal for this layer.
Triplanar ambient occlusion texture used for high elevations and steep slopes. The red channel is used; if unset, this layer uses full ambient light.
Triplanar parallax height texture used for high elevations and steep slopes. The red channel offsets material sampling only and does not change terrain geometry.
Roughness value blended by the high layer weight.
Triplanar roughness texture used for high elevations and steep slopes. The red channel is used; if unset, [member high_roughness] is used.
Triplanar albedo texture used for high elevations and steep slopes.
World-space triplanar texture scale for the high elevation layer.
Multiplier color for the low elevation layer.
Normalized height where the terrain blends from the low layer toward the mid layer.
Triplanar normal texture used for low elevations. If unset, the terrain uses its generated height normal for this layer.
Triplanar ambient occlusion texture used for low elevations. The red channel is used; if unset, this layer uses full ambient light.
Triplanar parallax height texture used for low elevations. The red channel offsets material sampling only and does not change terrain geometry.
Roughness value blended by the low layer weight.
Triplanar roughness texture used for low elevations. The red channel is used; if unset, [member low_roughness] is used.
Triplanar albedo texture used for low elevations.
World-space triplanar texture scale for the low elevation layer.
World-space scale for anti-tiling macro variation. Lower values produce larger color variation across the terrain.
Strength of the macro variation texture contribution. A value of [code]0.0[/code] disables the macro color modulation while leaving coordinate warping controlled by [member anti_tiling_strength].
Optional low-frequency color variation texture used by anti-tiling. The texture should repeat seamlessly and is sampled in world XZ space.
Multiplier color for the mid elevation layer.
Triplanar normal texture used for mid elevations. If unset, the terrain uses its generated height normal for this layer.
Triplanar ambient occlusion texture used for mid elevations. The red channel is used; if unset, this layer uses full ambient light.
Triplanar parallax height texture used for mid elevations. The red channel offsets material sampling only and does not change terrain geometry.
Roughness value blended by the mid layer weight.
Triplanar roughness texture used for mid elevations. The red channel is used; if unset, [member mid_roughness] is used.
Triplanar albedo texture used for mid elevations.
World-space triplanar texture scale for the mid elevation layer.
Legacy patch resolution setting retained for compatibility. Tiled rendering uses [member tile_size] for the active patch subdivision.
If enabled, parallax textures offset material sampling based on view direction. This is a visual material effect and does not modify terrain height data.
If enabled, inverts parallax texture height values before applying the sampling offset.
Distance where parallax sampling offsets fade fully to zero.
Distance where parallax sampling offsets begin fading out.
Strength of simple parallax sampling offsets. Keep this small to avoid texture swimming at grazing camera angles.
If enabled, the editor displays the terrain bounds gizmo while the node is selected.
Slope value where the high layer fully takes over steep surfaces.
Strength of the slope-based high layer contribution. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to use height blending only.
Slope value where the high layer starts blending onto steep surfaces.
Debug view for inspecting height, slope, automatic/final layer weights, or painted layer weights instead of final albedo.
Height field resource uploaded as a float height texture.

Array of [OpenWorldTerrainLayer] resources used to organize terrain materials and future generation metadata. In the current renderer, the first three enabled material layers are mapped to the low, mid, and high material slots. [member OpenWorldTerrainLayer.generation_role] can be used to separate height-generated terrain layers from surface-only layers such as roads and dirt paths.
Optional custom material. Used when [member use_builtin_displacement_material] is [code]false[/code].
Legacy compatibility alias for [member tile_resolution] minus one.
Convenience proxy to [member OpenWorldTerrainData.tile_resolution].
Convenience proxy to [member OpenWorldTerrainData.tile_world_size].
Compatibility world-space triplanar texture scale. Setting this value updates all layer-specific texture scales.
Controls how sharply triplanar projections blend by surface normal.
If enabled, the node creates a basic shader material that displaces vertices from the generated height texture.
Legacy compatibility alias for [member tile_world_size].

constants.constant: Blends normalized height values toward neighboring averages.
Blends normalized height values toward [member flatten_height].
Renders normalized terrain height as grayscale.
Renders low, mid, and high layer weights as red, green, and blue.
Renders painted low, mid, and high layer weights as red, green, and blue, multiplied by paint override alpha.
Replaces painted layer weights with the selected layer according to brush strength and falloff.
Multiplies existing painted layer weights by the selected layer color before applying brush strength and falloff.
Keeps the darker value between existing painted layer weights and the selected layer color before applying brush strength and falloff.
Keeps the lighter value between existing painted layer weights and the selected layer color before applying brush strength and falloff.
